candidates.change_summary: Change the returned constant from true to false so transfer always returns false after executing the calls.
Return the success flag of the last low-level call instead of always returning true, changing observable return based on callee behavior.
Return true only if all low-level calls succeeded (logical AND), changing return when any call fails locally without reverting.
Return true if any low-level call succeeded (logical OR), otherwise false, changing return based on callee behavior.
Replace low-level call with a high-level external call (transferFrom) which will revert on failure instead of silently continuing.
Change call to use staticcall, which will fail if target attempts state changes, altering observable behavior.
Check and require matching lengths of _tos and v arrays to prevent out-of-bounds and change behavior when lengths differ.
Stop swallowing return value: capture the returned bool and require it to be true so failures revert instead of being silent.
Reverse loop order so transfers occur in reverse sequence, which may change observable state after the call.
